lh_resource_types.other: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies the other/unclassified resource type.
lh_resource_types.stylesheet: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies the CSS stylesheet resource type.
lh_resource_types.image: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies the image files resource type.
lh_resource_types.media: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies the media files (video/audio) resource type.
lh_resource_types.third-party: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies resources loaded from third-party domains.
lh_resource_types.self: Row label in resource breakdown tables. Identifies resources loaded from the audited domain itself.

lh_resources_requests.table_caption: Table caption for the HTTP requests breakdown table by resource type and origin.
lh_resources_requests.data_types: Column header. Labels the data/resource type column.
lh_resources_requests.data_origin: Column header. Labels the origin (self vs third-party) column.
lh_resources_requests.data_absolute: Column header. Labels the absolute number of HTTP requests column.
lh_resources_requests.data_relative: Column header. Labels the percentage share column.

lh_resources_sizes.table_caption: Table caption for the data volume breakdown table by resource type and origin.
lh_resources_sizes.data_types: Column header. Labels the data/resource type column.
lh_resources_sizes.data_origin: Column header. Labels the origin (self vs third-party) column.
lh_resources_sizes.data_absolute: Column header. Labels the absolute data volume column (in kilobytes).
lh_resources_sizes.data_relative: Column header. Labels the percentage share column.

questions.main: Q&A section question heading. Shown as a bold question above the overall score summary answer. Asks about the site's overall ECOS performance.
questions.e: Q&A section question heading. Shown as a bold question above the Efficiency score answer. Asks about loading speed and data transfer efficiency.
questions.c: Q&A section question heading. Shown as a bold question above the Clean score answer. Asks about the site's carbon footprint.
questions.o: Q&A section question heading. Shown as a bold question above the Open score answer. Asks about accessibility and discoverability.
questions.s: Q&A section question heading. Shown as a bold question above the Safe score answer. Asks about technical security.

tiers.top10: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores in the top 10%. Contains the score as a placeholder.
tiers.top25: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores in the top 25%. Contains the score as a placeholder.
tiers.top50: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores above the median. Contains the score as a placeholder.
tiers.bottom50: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores below the median. Contains the score as a placeholder.
tiers.bottom25: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores in the bottom 25%. Contains the score as a placeholder.
tiers.bottom10: Q&A answer sentence. Shown below the main question when the site scores in the bottom 10%. Contains the score as a placeholder.

score_half_donut.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the semi-circle score display widget. Short label.
score_half_donut.aria_label: ARIA label for the semi-circle score display widget. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart and scale.

file_composition_requests.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the requests breakdown donut chart.
file_composition_requests.aria_label: ARIA label for the requests breakdown donut chart. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and content.

file_composition_size.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the data volume breakdown donut chart.
file_composition_size.aria_label: ARIA label for the data volume breakdown donut chart. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and content.

http_archive_comparison.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the HTTP Archive benchmark boxplot chart.
http_archive_comparison.aria_label: ARIA label for the HTTP Archive benchmark boxplot chart. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and what it compares.

crux_histogram.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the CrUX performance distribution histogram.
crux_histogram.aria_label: ARIA label for the CrUX performance distribution histogram. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and content.

score_tree_diagram.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the ECOS score composition tree diagram.
score_tree_diagram.aria_label: ARIA label for the ECOS score composition tree diagram. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the diagram structure and purpose.

true.title: Title attribute for a positive/true indicator icon (e.g. a checkmark). Single word.
true.aria_label: ARIA label for a positive/true indicator icon. Read aloud by screen readers. Single word.

false.title: Title attribute for a negative/false indicator icon (e.g. a cross). Single word.
false.aria_label: ARIA label for a negative/false indicator icon. Read aloud by screen readers. Single word.

request_new_audit.msg_1: Informational sentence shown above the 'request new audit' link. Tells the user when the last audit was performed. Contains the date as a placeholder.
request_new_audit.link_label: Link/button label. Triggers a request for a new audit of the same URL.

data_downloads.license: Label shown next to the license information in the downloads section. Single word.

page_audit_compact.name: Download item name. Short title for the compact audit scores JSON download.
page_audit_compact.description: Download item description. One sentence explaining what the compact JSON contains.

page_audit_full.name: Download item name. Short title for the full audit detail JSON download.
page_audit_full.description: Download item description. One sentence explaining what the full JSON contains.

page_history.name: Download item name. Short title for the audit history JSON download.
page_history.description: Download item description. One sentence explaining what the history JSON contains.

stats.name: Download item name. Short title for the ECOS benchmark statistics JSON download.
stats.description: Download item description. One sentence explaining what the statistics JSON contains.

audit_warnings.msg_1: Warning message shown at the top of the audit page when errors occurred during analysis. One sentence.
audit_warnings.show_details: Link/button label. Expands a panel showing the technical error details.

http_observatory_results.csp-not-implemented: Status message in the HTTP Observatory results table. Describes the outcome of the CSP test when no CSP header is present.
http_observatory_results.csp-implemented-with-unsafe-inline: Status message. Describes CSP being present but allowing unsafe inline scripts.
http_observatory_results.csp-implemented-with-unsafe-eval: Status message. Describes CSP being present but allowing unsafe eval.
http_observatory_results.csp-implemented-with-unsafe-wildcards: Status message. Describes CSP being present but using unsafe wildcards.
http_observatory_results.csp-implemented-with-no-unsafe: Status message. Describes a correctly implemented CSP with no unsafe directives.
http_observatory_results.csp-implemented-with-nonces-or-hashes: Status message. Describes a CSP using nonces or hashes (earns bonus points).
http_observatory_results.hsts-not-implemented: Status message. Describes the HSTS header being absent.
http_observatory_results.hsts-invalid: Status message. Describes an invalid HSTS header being present.
http_observatory_results.hsts-less-than-six-months: Status message. Describes HSTS being configured with a max-age below six months.
http_observatory_results.hsts-implemented-max-age-at-least-six-mo: Status message. Describes a correctly configured HSTS header.
http_observatory_results.hsts-preload-enabled: Status message. Describes HSTS preloading being enabled (earns bonus points).
http_observatory_results.x-content-type-options-not-implemented: Status message. Describes the X-Content-Type-Options header being absent.
http_observatory_results.x-content-type-options-nosniff: Status message. Describes the X-Content-Type-Options header being correctly set.
http_observatory_results.x-frame-options-not-implemented: Status message. Describes the X-Frame-Options header being absent.
http_observatory_results.x-frame-options-implemented: Status message. Describes the X-Frame-Options header being correctly implemented.
http_observatory_results.x-frame-options-invalid: Status message. Describes the X-Frame-Options header having an invalid value.
http_observatory_results.referrer-policy-not-implemented: Status message. Describes the Referrer-Policy header being absent.
http_observatory_results.referrer-policy-unsafe: Status message. Describes the Referrer-Policy being set to an unsafe value.
http_observatory_results.referrer-policy-safe: Status message. Describes the Referrer-Policy being set to a safe value.
http_observatory_results.referrer-policy-unknown: Status message. Describes the Referrer-Policy having an unrecognized value.
http_observatory_results.cookies-not-found: Status message. Describes no cookies being detected on the page.
http_observatory_results.cookies-secure: Status message. Describes all cookies using the recommended security flags (earns bonus points).
http_observatory_results.cookies-without-secure-flag: Status message. Describes cookies being set without the Secure flag.
http_observatory_results.cookies-without-httponly-flag: Status message. Describes cookies being set without the HttpOnly flag.
http_observatory_results.cookies-without-samesite-flag: Status message. Describes cookies being set without the SameSite flag.
http_observatory_results.cross-origin-resource-sharing-not-implem: Status message. Describes content not being accessible via CORS.
http_observatory_results.cross-origin-resource-sharing-implemente: Status message. Describes CORS being configured with a wildcard allowing all origins.
Status message. Describes CORS being configured with specific allowed origins.
http_observatory_results.redirection-not-to-https: Status message. Describes the site not redirecting to HTTPS.
http_observatory_results.redirection-to-https-on-different-hostna: Status message. Describes an HTTPS redirect going to a different hostname.
http_observatory_results.redirection-to-https: Status message. Describes a correct HTTPS redirect on the same hostname.
http_observatory_results.redirection-all-https: Status message. Describes the site already using HTTPS.
http_observatory_results.corp-implemented: Status message. Describes the Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy header being implemented (earns bonus points).
http_observatory_results.coop-implemented: Status message. Describes the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header being implemented (earns bonus points).
http_observatory_results.coep-implemented: Status message. Describes the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy header being implemented (earns bonus points).

http_observatory_labels.hol_results_caption: Table caption for the HTTP Observatory summary results table.
http_observatory_labels.hol_orgingal_score: Table row label. Identifies the raw HTTP Observatory score row. Note: key has a typo ('orgingal') — do not change the key.
http_observatory_labels.hol_grade: Table row label. Identifies the HTTP Observatory letter grade row.
http_observatory_labels.hol_tests: Table row group label. Groups the passed/failed test count rows.
http_observatory_labels.hol_passed: Table row label. Identifies the number of passed tests row.
http_observatory_labels.hol_failed: Table row label. Identifies the number of failed tests row.
http_observatory_labels.hol_details_caption: Table caption for the detailed HTTP Observatory test results table.
http_observatory_labels.hol_test: Column header. Labels the test name column in the HTTP Observatory details table.
http_observatory_labels.hol_description: Column header. Labels the description column in the HTTP Observatory details table.
http_observatory_labels.hol_modifier: Column header. Labels the score modifier (positive/negative points) column.
http_observatory_labels.hol_result: Column header. Labels the result/status column in the HTTP Observatory details table.

http_observatory_tests.content-security-policy: Row label in the HTTP Observatory test details table. Name of the CSP test.
http_observatory_tests.strict-transport-security: Row label. Name of the HSTS test.
http_observatory_tests.content-security-policy-strict: Row label. Name of the CSP strictness test.
http_observatory_tests.strict-transport-security-preload: Row label. Name of the HSTS preloading test.
http_observatory_tests.x-content-type-options: Row label. Name of the content type protection test.
http_observatory_tests.x-frame-options: Row label. Name of the clickjacking protection test.
http_observatory_tests.referrer-policy: Row label. Name of the referrer policy test.
http_observatory_tests.cookies: Row label. Name of the cookie security test.
http_observatory_tests.cross-origin-resource-sharing-not-implem: Row label. Name of the CORS status test.
http_observatory_tests.cross-origin-resource-sharing: Row label. Name of the cross-origin resource sharing test.
http_observatory_tests.redirection: Row label. Name of the HTTPS redirection test.
http_observatory_tests.cross-origin-resource-policy: Row label. Name of the CORP test. Keep acronym in parentheses.
http_observatory_tests.cross-origin-opener-policy: Row label. Name of the COOP test. Keep acronym in parentheses.
http_observatory_tests.cross-origin-embedder-policy: Row label. Name of the COEP test. Keep acronym in parentheses.

badge.generate_code: Button label. Triggers generation of the embed code for the audit badge.
badge.code_copied_to_clipboard: Success notification message. Shown briefly after the embed code is copied to clipboard.
badge.size: Form field label. Labels the size selector for the badge.
badge.color_theme_light: Radio button / option label. Selects the light color theme for the badge.
badge.color_theme_dark: Radio button / option label. Selects the dark color theme for the badge.
badge.color_theme_system: Radio button / option label. Selects the system/auto color theme for the badge.
badge.color_theme_label: Form field label. Labels the color theme selector group.
badge.color_theme_desc: Help text shown below the color theme selector. Explains how the System mode works. Contains HTML code elements, preserve them.
badge.code_format_label: Form field label. Labels the code format selector group (HTML vs React).
badge.code_format_desc: Help text shown below the code format selector. Explains when to use HTML vs React format. Contains HTML code elements, preserve them.
